content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps. There is no affidavit from Complainant, and no statement from C1, the alleged harasser, appears in the record. Coworkers who supposedly approached Complainant about the rumor were not identified or interviewed. The Acting Lead Manager and Plant Manager, who were also told of the harassment, are not addressed. The conflict over what was reported is unresolved: S1 forwarded a PS-13 in October 2018, while the Lead Manager said the rumors were not reported to her. Management's actual response (the separation, any anti-harassment inquiry) was not documented. No one was asked about the August 7, 2018 investigative interview, such as who conducted it, why, or how comparators were treated. No one was asked about the alleged disclosure of medical information. The decision rests mainly on the absence of corroboration, which mostly stems from the lack of an investigation, so the conclusion cannot be reliably evaluated."}
